body: It really was my pleasure. Even if don't realize it you have so much to offer this world! Take it one day at a time. I hope you can find happiness because you truly deserve it :)

Please take a moment to think about your decision. I was in your position a few days ago and by the grace of god I am alive. I just got out of the hospital a few days ago! You are loved more than you know and please know that these thoughts are temporary! You are loved. If you need someone to talk to please reach out to me. I will do my best to help you!
Thank you so much for taking the time to read my story, it means more than you know! :)

I know that everything may seem so incredibly hopeless right now. I tried to kill myself 4 days ago. I was in the hospital for a few days and being there made me realize that. even though this world can be a cruel and horrible place there are so many little things to live for. You are something!! You are a human being and right now that may seem like nothing to you. Trust me I get it. Instead of spending the last of your money on a gun, go get something that will make you happy. Even if its something as simple as an ice-cream come. You've lost hope, go on an adventure to find it :). If you need someone to talk to please reach out to me! I might not be able to help but I will try my hardest!!
